description: Department of Archaeology - The Antiquities Ordinance (Chapter 188) Order under Section 18 (Amitiyagoda Wijeyaratne Walauwa)
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notice exercising powers under the Antiquities Ordinance (Chapter 188) to declare that a previously protected monument shall cease to be protected. It involves a regulatory action (revoking protected status) under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5). While it names a minister, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail (only states his title) and the primary purpose is regulatory/legal action rather than personnel appointment or government restructuring.
